title: Sushi Masterclass in Washington D.C. (Includes 4-Course Meal)
includes: Cozy Washington D.C. venue for an intimate, hands-on experience
Small group size (maximum 8 guests) for personalized instruction
Full 4-course menu with salad, maki rolls, special rolls and hand rolls
This is a BYOB event. Guests are welcome to bring wine and beer to enjoy during the class (not included)
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
policies: This cooking class is designed to accommodate a variety of dietary needs! Please let us know in advance, and we'll do our best to tailor the experience to suit your preferences and restrictions.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Uncover the artistry of sushi-making in Washington D.C. during this immersive class hosted through Cozymeal. Limited to 8 guests, the workshop blends essential Japanese techniques with a diverse four-course menu.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Starter: Tuna sesame salad with a light, tangy dressing
- Sushi maki: Spicy tuna roll, avocado cream cheese roll and spicy California roll
- Special maki: Spicy double tuna roll and caterpillar roll layered with avocado
- Temaki: Tuna, eel and California hand rolls

With step-by-step instruction from your sushi chef, you’ll learn precision rolling, knife skills and plating for sushi that balances flavor, texture and presentation.
